pairs: all 32 registered Stage B pairs, 16 per phase
truth: unchanged Stage B physical R7 truth at observed-coordinate cells
primary: galaxy-weighted paired fractions at threshold 0.2, original operator; corrected is matched comparison
moment_accounting: e=posterior mean minus truth; S=unbiased within-ensemble covariance; Q=mean(ee^T)-mean(S)/M; Q=bb^T+Q_centered with population-normalized across-case scatter; no independence of cores assumed
interpretation: Q versus mean(S) is an aggregate diagnostic under independent conditional posterior draws; centered excess may reflect heterogeneous conditional bias, not only narrow spread; two dependent-region panels cannot identify conditional calibration
bias_transfer: subtract the equal-core four-class mean error learned only from the OTHER development phase, separately by operator, threshold and weighting; exploratory cross-development diagnostic, not fresh validation or train-only calibration
sensitivity_arms: cross product of no shift / other-phase bias subtraction and the three fixed spread multipliers; no fitting or choice of best multiplier
affine_guard: transform fractions as mean - bias + scale*(draw-mean); preserve sums but do not clip; report out-of-simplex vector rates; summary-space sensitivity only, never physical density/field draws
dependence_probe: all 32 cyclic offsets of the right-core draw index, including identity; preserves both complete four-class core marginal ensembles, average cross-covariance exactly zero; average joint-rank response is sensitivity, not an exchangeable calibration null
dependence_scope: primary threshold 0.2 only, both operators and weightings; never independently shuffle classes within a simplex
stage_a_connection: same moment accounting on saved coarse/fine shear projections in canvas_coarse_local_fine and oracle_coarse_local_fine; retain their matched local operator truth, do not equate these summaries with full-cap B2 truth
small_group_policy: fewer than four pairs: unavailable matrix diagnostic; classwise summaries retain counts; no iid confidence intervals
numerics: retain negative draw-noise-adjusted moments; no positive-semidefinite clipping; eigenvalues use diagnostic floor 1e-8 times mean predictive variance, minimum 1e-15
stop_rule: deliver failure decomposition and one justified next hypothesis, or explicitly decline an intervention; no automated training, new field sampling, phase opening or promotion
compute: one interactive CPU node at most one hour; no GPU required for saved summaries
